en.name: GadgetNest
en.subtitle: Compare tech before you buy
en.short_description: Compare phones, laptops and parts on price and spec, and watch prices.
en.description:
GadgetNest is for the part of buying a gadget that happens before you buy it.

BROWSE AND COMPARE
Work through categories, open a product for its full specs, and put several side by side. GadgetNest marks which one is the better deal and says why.

PRICE HISTORY
A chart of what a product has cost over time, so "on sale" has to prove itself.

BUILD LIST
Collect the parts of a build in one list and keep the total in front of you.

SAVED
Keep the products you are still thinking about.

STRAIGHT ANSWERS
GadgetNest earns a commission on some outbound links. It does not reorder results because of it, and everything it stores stays on your device — there is no account and one button erases the lot.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
GadgetNest is for the part of buying a gadget that happens before you buy it.

Intended audience:
Compare tech before you buy

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (locale 1, locale 10, locale 11, locale 12, locale 2, locale 3, locale 4, locale 5, locale 6, locale 7, locale 8, locale 9). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
